The Authority will have the authority to set new programs for the development plans of various departments. Discussions are underway on the formation of a highway authority, but it has not taken concrete form and has been overshadowed by the issue of a development authority. काठमाडौं । सरकारले विकास निर्माणसँग सम्बन्धित सबै विभाग र निकायलाई एउटै बास्केटमा राखि राष्ट्रिय विकास प्राधिकरण निर्माण गर्ने तयारी गरेको छ । साथै यसको कार्यकारी अधिकृतमा पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्री सुनील लम्सालका विज्ञ सल्लाहकार सुशील ज्ञवालीलाई नियुक्ति गर्ने तयारी भएको छ । पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय स्रोतका अनुसार विकास प्राधिकरण गठन आदेश अध्यादेश ल्याएर विकास प्राधिकरण गर्ने तयारी सरकारको छ । अध्यादेशको मस्यौदा समेत पूरा भइसकेको छ । कानुन मन्त्रालयले मस्यौदा तयार गरेको हो । स्रोतका अनुसार उक्त प्राधिकरण मन्त्रिपरिषद् तथा प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय मातहतमा रहनेछ । यसको नेतृत्व प्रमख आयुक्तले गर्ने छ । प्रमुख आयुक्तको मयार्दाक्रम मन्त्री सरहको हुनेछ । यसको कार्यकारी अधिकृत राजनीतिक नियुक्ति हुनेछ । यस विषयामा सोध्दा पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयका सचिव पदम मैनालीले राष्ट्रिय विकास प्राधिकरण गठन गर्ने तयारी भइरहेको बताए । थप बोल्न चाहेनन । ‘सबै कुरा अहिले नै भन्न मिल्दैन । प्राधिकरण गठन गर्ने तयारी भइरहेको साँचो हो’, उनले भने । स्रोतका अनुसार आगामी मंसिर १२-१३ गते काठमाडौंमा हुने पूर्वाधार सम्मेलनलाई लक्षित गरी विकास प्राधिकरण गठन गर्न लागिएको हो । यस प्राधिकरणको अधिकारभित्र पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय मातहतका सडका विभाग, सहरी विकास तथा भवन निर्माण विभाग, स्थानीय पूर्वाधार विभाग (डोली), खानेपानी विभाग मात्र नभइ उर्जा,जलस्रोत तथा सिँचाइ मन्त्रालय मातहतको सिँचाइ विभाग समेत रहने छ । यी विभाग मातहतका विकास योजनाहरुको नयाँ कार्यक्रम तय गर्ने, ठेक्का टेण्डर निकाल्ने, सूचना निकाल्ने, ठेकेदारसँग सहमति गर्ने, ठेक्का रद्द गर्ने, जस्ता अधिकार समेत प्राधिकरणलाई हुने छ ।प्राधिकरणलाई अधिकारसम्पन्न बनाइएको छ । विकास निर्माणका सबै निकाय र कामलाई एकै ठाउँमा राखी छुट्टै निकाय गठन गर्दा त्यसको काम प्रभावकारी हुने सिद्धान्तमा यो प्राधिकरण गठन गर्न लागिएको बताइएको छ । प्रधानमन्त्रीको कार्यालयले गत असोजमै सिँचाइ विभागलाई समेत पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयमै गाभ्न चाहेको थियो । मन्त्रिपरिषद्को बैठकमा समेत यस विषयमा कुरा उठेको थियो । सिँचाइ विभागलाई पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयमा गाभ्दा ऊर्जा विकास तथा सिँचाइ मन्त्रालयको अधिकार खोसिने भएपछि मन्त्रिपरिषद्को बैठकमै ऊर्जामन्त्री विराजभक्त श्रेष्ठले आपत्ति जनाएका थिए । त्यसपछि त्यो विषय त्यतिकै थाती राखिएको थियो । वालेन्द्र शाह प्रधानमन्त्रीमा नियुक्ति भएपछि तत्कालीन तीन विकासे मन्त्रालय सहरी विकास, भौतिक पूर्वाधार यातायात, तथा खानेपानीलाई गाभेर पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय गठन गरिएको थियो । त्यसमा सिँचाइ विभागलाई समेत गाभी पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयलाई अझै शक्तिशाली बनाउने प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालको तयारी थियो । स्रोतका अनुसार गत भदौ १३ गते पूर्वाधार विकासमन्त्री लम्सालको विज्ञ सल्लाहकारमा नियुक्ति भएका ज्ञवालीलाई प्राधिकरणको कार्यकारी अधिकृतमा नियुक्ति गर्ने तयारी सरकारको छ । गत भदौ १० गते भोटेकोसीमा आएको बिनाशकारी बाढी पछि ज्ञवालीलाई विज्ञ सल्लाहकारमा नियुक्ति गरिएको थियो । २०७२ सालको भूकम्पपछि गठन भएको पुननिर्माण प्राधिकरणमा नेकपा एमाले सरकारमा हुँदा प्राधिकरणको सीईओमा ज्ञवालीलाई नियुक्त गरिएको थियो । ज्ञवाली नगर विकास कोषका पूर्व कार्यकारी निर्देशक तथा लगानी बोर्डका पूर्वसीईओ समेत हुन । हाइवे प्राधिकरण गठन गर्ने विषय चर्चामात्रै पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय मातहतका उच्च कर्मचारीहरूको बैठकमा हाइवे प्राधिकरण गठन गर्ने विषयमा बेला बेलामा चर्चा र छलफल हुने गरेको छ । तर, यस विषयले ठोस रुप लिन नसकेको पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयका एक सहसचिवले बताए । उनले भने, ‘विकास प्राधिकरण विषय आइसकेपछि हाइवे प्राधिकरणको विषय ओझेल परेको छ । तर, हाइवे प्राधिकरण गठन गर्नु पर्ने विषय भने हो ।’ देशभरीका सबै ठूला-ठूला राष्ट्रिय राजमार्गहरूको मर्मत सम्भार, स्तरोन्नति, टोल टयाक्स, तथा अनुगमन गर्ने उद्देश्यबाट हाइवे प्राधिकरणको अवधारणा तयार गरिएको हो । Kathmandu. The government is preparing to form the National Development Authority by putting all departments and agencies related to development in one basket. It is also preparing to appoint Sushil Gyawali, expert advisor to Infrastructure Development Minister Sunil Lamsal, as its executive officer. According to sources in the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, the government is preparing to establish a development authority by bringing an ordinance to form the development authority. The draft of the ordinance has also been completed. The draft has been prepared by the Ministry of Law. According to sources, the authority will be under the Council of Ministers and the Prime Minister's Office. It will be headed by a Chief Commissioner. The Chief Commissioner's rank will be similar to that of a minister. Its executive officer will be a political appointee. When asked about this, Padam Mainali, Secretary of the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, said that preparations are underway to form a National Development Authority. He did not want to say more. "It is not possible to say everything right now. It is true that preparations are underway to form the authority," he said. According to sources, the development authority is being formed with the aim of the infrastructure conference to be held in Kathmandu on November 12-13. The authority will include not only the Road Department, Urban Development and Building Construction Department, Local Infrastructure Department (DOLI), and Water Supply Department under the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, but also the Irrigation Department under the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation. The authority will also have the power to set new programs for development plans under these departments, issue contract tenders, issue notices, reach agreements with contractors, and cancel contracts. The authority has been made fully empowered. It is said that this authority is being formed on the principle that by keeping all the development and construction bodies and works in one place, its work will be effective. The Prime Minister's Office had wanted to merge the Irrigation Department with the Ministry of Infrastructure Development in October last year. The issue was also raised in the Council of Ministers meeting. Energy Minister Biraj Bhakta Shrestha had objected to the merger of the Irrigation Department with the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, saying that the powers of the Ministry of Energy Development and Irrigation would be taken away. After that, the issue was shelved. After Balendra Shah was appointed as Prime Minister, the Ministry of Infrastructure Development was formed by merging the then three development ministries - Urban Development, Physical Infrastructure, Transport, and Drinking Water. The Prime Minister's Office was preparing to merge the Irrigation Department into the Ministry of Infrastructure Development to make it even more powerful. According to sources, the government is preparing to appoint Gyawali, who was appointed as an expert advisor to Infrastructure Development Minister Lamsal on Bhadra 13, as the executive officer of the NEA. Gyawali was appointed as an expert advisor after the devastating floods in Bhotekoshi on Bhadra 10. Gyawali was appointed as the CEO of the Reconstruction Authority formed after the 2072 BS earthquake when the CPN-UML was in power. Gyawali is also the former Executive Director of the Municipal Development Fund and the former CEO of the Investment Board. The issue of forming a highway authority is only a matter of discussion. The issue of forming a highway authority has been discussed and debated from time to time in meetings of senior officials under the Ministry of Infrastructure Development. However, a joint secretary at the Ministry of Infrastructure Development said that this issue has not yet taken a concrete form. He said, "After the development authority issue came up, the issue of the highway authority has been overshadowed. However, the issue of forming a highway authority is still there." The concept of the highway authority has been prepared with the aim of maintaining, upgrading, collecting tolls, and monitoring all major national highways across the country.

The government is preparing to form the National Development Authority by putting all departments and agencies related to development in one basket. It is also preparing to appoint Sushil Gyawali, expert advisor to Infrastructure Development Minister Sunil Lamsal, as its executive officer. According to sources in the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, the government is preparing to establish a development authority by bringing an ordinance to form the development authority. The draft of the ordinance has also been completed. The draft has been prepared by the Ministry of Law. According to sources, the authority will be under the Council of Ministers and the Prime Minister's Office. It will be headed by a Chief Commissioner. The Chief Commissioner's rank will be similar to that of a minister. Its executive officer will be a political appointee. When asked about this, Padam Mainali, Secretary of the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, said that preparations are underway to form a National Development Authority. He did not want to say more. "It is not possible to say everything right now. It is true that preparations are underway to form the authority," he said. According to sources, the development authority is being formed with the aim of the infrastructure conference to be held in Kathmandu on November 12-13. The authority will include not only the Road Department, Urban Development and Building Construction Department, Local Infrastructure Department (DOLI), and Water Supply Department under the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, but also the Irrigation Department under the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation. The authority will also have the power to set new programs for development plans under these departments, issue contract tenders, issue notices, reach agreements with contractors, and cancel contracts. The authority has been made fully empowered. It is said that this authority is being formed on the principle that by keeping all the development and construction bodies and works in one place, its work will be effective. The Prime Minister's Office had wanted to merge the Irrigation Department with the Ministry of Infrastructure Development in October last year. The issue was also raised in the Council of Ministers meeting. Energy Minister Biraj Bhakta Shrestha had objected to the merger of the Irrigation Department with the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, saying that the powers of the Ministry of Energy Development and Irrigation would be taken away. After that, the issue was shelved. After Balendra Shah was appointed as Prime Minister, the Ministry of Infrastructure Development was formed by merging the then three development ministries - Urban Development, Physical Infrastructure, Transport, and Drinking Water. The Prime Minister's Office was preparing to merge the Irrigation Department into the Ministry of Infrastructure Development to make it even more powerful. According to sources, the government is preparing to appoint Gyawali, who was appointed as an expert advisor to Infrastructure Development Minister Lamsal on Bhadra 13, as the executive officer of the NEA. Gyawali was appointed as an expert advisor after the devastating floods in Bhotekoshi on Bhadra 10. Gyawali was appointed as the CEO of the Reconstruction Authority formed after the 2072 BS earthquake when the CPN-UML was in power. Gyawali is also the former Executive Director of the Municipal Development Fund and the former CEO of the Investment Board. The issue of forming a highway authority is only a matter of discussion. The issue of forming a highway authority has been discussed and debated from time to time in meetings of senior officials under the Ministry of Infrastructure Development. However, a joint secretary at the Ministry of Infrastructure Development said that this issue has not yet taken a concrete form. He said, "After the development authority issue came up, the issue of the highway authority has been overshadowed. However, the issue of forming a highway authority is still there." The concept of the highway authority has been prepared with the aim of maintaining, upgrading, collecting tolls, and monitoring all major national highways across the country.

वालेन्द्र शाह प्रधानमन्त्रीमा नियुक्ति भएपछि तत्कालीन तीन विकासे मन्त्रालय सहरी विकास, भौतिक पूर्वाधार यातायात, तथा खानेपानीलाई गाभेर पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय गठन गरिएको थियो । त्यसमा सिँचाइ विभागलाई समेत गाभी पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयलाई अझै शक्तिशाली बनाउने प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालको तयारी थियो ।

स्रोतका अनुसार गत भदौ १३ गते पूर्वाधार विकासमन्त्री लम्सालको विज्ञ सल्लाहकारमा नियुक्ति भएका ज्ञवालीलाई प्राधिकरणको कार्यकारी अधिकृतमा नियुक्ति गर्ने तयारी सरकारको छ । गत भदौ १० गते भोटेकोसीमा आएको बिनाशकारी बाढी पछि ज्ञवालीलाई विज्ञ सल्लाहकारमा नियुक्ति गरिएको थियो ।

२०७२ सालको भूकम्पपछि गठन भएको पुननिर्माण प्राधिकरणमा नेकपा एमाले सरकारमा हुँदा प्राधिकरणको सीईओमा ज्ञवालीलाई नियुक्त गरिएको थियो । ज्ञवाली नगर विकास कोषका पूर्व कार्यकारी निर्देशक तथा लगानी बोर्डका पूर्वसीईओ समेत हुन ।

पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालय मातहतका उच्च कर्मचारीहरूको बैठकमा हाइवे प्राधिकरण गठन गर्ने विषयमा बेला बेलामा चर्चा र छलफल हुने गरेको छ । तर, यस विषयले ठोस रुप लिन नसकेको पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयका एक सहसचिवले बताए ।

उनले भने, ‘विकास प्राधिकरण विषय आइसकेपछि हाइवे प्राधिकरणको विषय ओझेल परेको छ । तर, हाइवे प्राधिकरण गठन गर्नु पर्ने विषय भने हो ।’ देशभरीका सबै ठूला-ठूला राष्ट्रिय राजमार्गहरूको मर्मत सम्भार, स्तरोन्नति, टोल टयाक्स, तथा अनुगमन गर्ने उद्देश्यबाट हाइवे प्राधिकरणको अवधारणा तयार गरिएको हो ।

The concept of the highway authority has been prepared with the aim of maintaining, upgrading, collecting tolls, and monitoring all major national highways across the country.
